info.title: pigateway API
info.description: The Pi device gateway: ATEM, cameras, the Atlona matrix (through the AMX master) and the Matrox Monarch HDX encoder. Writes under /api/v1 need X-Api-Key or a Bearer token unless the client is on PIGATEWAY_AUTH_ALLOWED_HOSTS. PiVoice activity-triggered Auditor sessions are coordinated by PiGateway; configure PIGATEWAY_PIVOICE_API_URL and PIGATEWAY_PIVOICE_API_TOKEN. Idle-close is controlled at /api/v1/activity/idle-close. Radio lifecycle controls are exposed through /api/v1/radio-relay/* and forwarded to the configured web-radio-relay service.

post.description: Standard VISCA CAM_Focus auto or manual. Auto also ends a privacy blur. Not yet verified on a real PTZ330.

get.summary: Read the camera's FreeD output settings

502.description: The camera CGI did not answer or rejected the request

post.summary: Turn the camera's FreeD output on or off, optionally setting the target
post.description: Sends the FreeD target (when `target` is given) through the camera CGI, switches FreeD on or off, then reads the state back. Uses the camera's CGI port and login. Commands follow the camera web UI; not yet verified on a real PTZ330 beyond the read-back.

502.description: The camera CGI did not answer or rejected the request

post.summary: Move camera pan/tilt
post.description: Drives pan/tilt continuously or stops motion using VISCA over IP.

post.summary: Wake the camera or send it to standby
post.description: Standard VISCA CAM_Power. `on: true` wakes the camera from standby, `on: false` sends it to standby. The command leaves from UDP source port 52381 (configurable per camera). Tested on cam1 only.

post.summary: Recall camera preset
post.description: Recalls a saved preset (0-254) on the camera via VISCA CAM_Memory.

post.summary: Save current camera position to preset
post.description: Saves the current position, zoom, and image state to a preset (0-254) via VISCA CAM_Memory Set.

post.summary: Capture a thumbnail for a camera preset
Blur the picture for privacy
post.description: On switches the camera from autofocus to manual focus, sets the near focus limit to the closest distance and drives focus to the nearest point, so the picture is out of focus. Off restores the normal near limit (PIMATRIX_CAMERA_NEAR_LIMIT_M, default 1.5 m, unverified mapping) and returns the camera to autofocus. Uses standard VISCA focus commands; not yet verified on a real PTZ330.

post.summary: Control SmartFrame AI auto-framing
post.description: Enables, disables, or triggers one-shot SmartFrame auto framing.

post.summary: Start video streaming from camera to MediaMTX
post.description: Commands the camera to push its RTMP feed to MediaMTX or ensures MediaMTX is pulling RTSP.

post.summary: Stop video streaming from camera
Zoom camera in or out
post.description: Drives optical zoom tele/wide or stops zoom using VISCA over IP.

post.summary: Step 1: push exported Canva pages
post.description: Takes the https URLs of the pages exported by the Canva plugin, downloads them, and has Pi Program keep them as a presentation. Answers 202 with a task; poll it for download, unpacking and thumbnail progress and for `ready`.

orientation.description: landscape, portrait or both separated by a comma (default both)

useAt.description: Service date for the presentation, so Pi Program can have it ready: 2026-11-08, 2026-11-08T10, a range 2026-11-08/2026-11-09, or a list.

422.description: Invalid pages or a URL on a host that is not allowed

post.summary: Step 2: put a ready presentation on a pipeline
post.description: Adds the presentation to the pipeline, cues a slide and routes the Atlona to the chosen displays. With unblankProjectors the picture mute of both projectors is switched off; a failure is reported in `warnings`.

piOutput.description: Send the pipeline through this Pi output (Atlona input 3 or 4). Default: PiPGM1 uses Pi 1, PiPGM2 uses Pi 2.
